item.VAR_DESC: Check Preceding Document with dynamic coding

item.CODE:
data: lt_sales_key type table of vbeln.
rv_check_status = abap_true.
data(ls_step_data) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = iv_step_number ). loop at ls_step_data-reference_step assigning field-symbol(<lv_ref_step>). data(lt_ptf_keys) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_keys_of_touch_doc_of_step( iv_step_number = <lv_ref_step> ). append lines of lt_ptf_keys to lt_sales_key. endloop.
if lines( lt_sales_key[] ) < 2. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: we always expect 2 ref steps| ). return. endif.
data(lv_vbeln) = lt_sales_key[ 2 ]. select single vgbel from vbak into @data(lv_vgbel) where vbeln = @lv_vbeln. if lv_vgbel is initial or lv_vgbel <> lt_sales_key[ 1 ]. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: Preceding Document of { lv_vbeln } is { lv_vgbel } not as expected| ). return. else. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Success: Preceding Document of { lv_vbeln } is { lv_vgbel } | ). endif.

item.VAR_DESC: Check PAOBJNR not equal with dynamic coding

item.CODE:
data: lt_sales_key type table of vbeln. data: lt_vbap type standard table of vbap with empty key.
rv_check_status = abap_true.
data(ls_step_data) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = iv_step_number ). loop at ls_step_data-reference_step assigning field-symbol(<lv_ref_step>). data(lt_ptf_keys) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_keys_of_touch_doc_of_step( iv_step_number = <lv_ref_step> ). append lines of lt_ptf_keys to lt_sales_key. endloop.
loop at lt_sales_key assigning field-symbol(<fs_vbeln>). clear lt_vbap. select vbeln posnr paobjnr from vbap into corresponding fields of table lt_vbap where vbeln = <fs_vbeln>. if sy-subrc <> 0. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: { <fs_vbeln> } items not found| ). rv_check_status = abap_false. continue. endif. data(number_of_paojnr_expected) = lines( lt_vbap[] ). if line_exists( lt_vbap[ paobjnr = space ] ). io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: { <fs_vbeln> } items have no PAOBJNR| ). rv_check_status = abap_false. continue. endif. sort lt_vbap by vbeln posnr paobjnr. delete adjacent duplicates from lt_vbap comparing paobjnr. data(number_of_paobjnr_actual) = lines( lt_vbap[] ). if number_of_paojnr_expected <> number_of_paobjnr_actual. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: { <fs_vbeln> } items have identical PAOBJNR| ). rv_check_status = abap_false. continue. endif.
io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Success: { <fs_vbeln> } PAOBJNR check successfully| ).
endloop.
